targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT MAX(startdt) AS startdt
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND vismean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
    AND model = '$model'
)
SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  vismean,
  vislb,
  visub
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  vismean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND startdt = (SELECT startdt FROM selected_run)
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  vismean
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  vismean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT MAX(startdt) AS startdt
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND vismean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
    AND model = '$model'
)
SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  probvis15
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  vismean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND startdt = (SELECT startdt FROM selected_run)
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT DISTINCT ON (locname)
  locname AS "Location",
  timestamp AS "Last Updated",
  vismean AS "Predicted Visibility"
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  vismean IS NOT NULL
  AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
ORDER BY locname, timestamp DESC

SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  windspdmean,
  windspdlb,
  windspdub
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
  AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM forecast_data
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND locname = '$location'
      AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
      AND model = '$model'
      AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))
      AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "time",
  windspdmean AS windspdmean,
  windspdlb AS windspdlb,
  windspdub AS windspdub
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
  AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM forecast_data
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND locname = '$location'
      AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
      AND model = '$model'
      AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
      AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY "time"

panels.description: Timestamp of the most recent forecast sample, shown in the browser's local time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT MAX(timestamp) AS "Data Time" FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))
  AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ

SELECT
  windspdmean
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))
  AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
ORDER BY timestamp DESC, startdt DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

  AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
ORDER BY timestamp DESC, startdt DESC NULLS LAST

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT MAX(startdt) AS startdt
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE htsgw IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(MAX(htsgw)::numeric, 1) AS value
FROM forecast_data
WHERE htsgw IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
  AND startdt = (SELECT startdt FROM selected_run)

SELECT
  ROUND(perpw::numeric, 1) AS value
FROM forecast_data
WHERE perpw IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
  AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  ROUND(dirpw::numeric, 0) AS value
FROM forecast_data
WHERE dirpw IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
  AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  winddirmean,
  winddirlb,
  winddirub
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' <> 'wind_nbm'
  AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM forecast_data
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND locname = '$location'
      AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
      AND model = '$model'
      AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))
      AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "time",
  winddirmean,
  winddirlb,
  winddirub
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' = 'wind_nbm'
  AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM forecast_data
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND locname = '$location'
      AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
      AND model = '$model'
      AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
      AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY "time"

SELECT
  locname AS "Location",
  COALESCE(height_m, 20) AS "Height (m)",
  timestamp AS "Last Updated",
  windspdmean AS "Wind Speed"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (locname, COALESCE(height_m, 20))
    locname,
    height_m,
    timestamp,
    windspdmean
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = 'grp_pascagoula'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  ORDER BY locname, COALESCE(height_m, 20), timestamp DESC, startdt DESC NULLS LAST
) sub
ORDER BY locname, "Height (m)"
